title: Campaigns OS Source HTML Manifest v0
description: Producer-authored manifest consumed by Campaigns OS prepare-build. Paths are relative to the source HTML root, not the .campaigns-os directory.

generator.description: Producer identity such as figma-sections-export@1.2.3 or reference-ai-producer@1.0.0.

root.description: Optional producer hint. Manifest page paths still resolve relative to the source root passed to prepare-build.

wrapper_policy.description: Optional operator selection of the document-wrapper policy for this source, in the same vocabulary the Build Packet records at source_html.adapter_contract.wrapper_policy. prepare-build seeds the adapter contract from it, so declaring "preserve_document_wrappers" here reports source_html.prep.document_wrapper without blocking instead of requiring the wrappers to be stripped. The prepare-build --wrapper-policy flag overrides this key; with neither, the default is "strip_document_wrappers". A value outside the enum does not invalidate the manifest: the key is ignored with a warning naming it, the value, and the accepted values, and the rest of the manifest is used as written. See docs/source-adapters.md, section "Source preparation check".

producer_provenance.description: Optional producer evidence. Required by doctor for Figma exporter manifests.

source_type.description: For figma-sections-export output this must be semantic_figma_export.

files.description: Optional material inventory for drift/provenance checks.

items.description: Exactly one of path (bind a source HTML file) or skip_reason (declare the page out of source scope) is required per entry; the oneOf below enforces the exclusion.

page_id.description: Active CampaignSpec page id. This is the primary join key.

skip_reason.description: Reason this active page carries no source HTML (e.g. template-derived).

page_type.description: Optional producer page type used for fallback matching only.

page_url.description: Optional producer/spec route used for fallback matching after Page Kit route normalization.

source_hash.description: Optional sha256 of the source HTML file at manifest generation time.

screenshots.description: Operator-authored source screenshot proof for this page, consumed by prepare-build when it synthesizes the Design Source Package. A renderable primary-design page clears DESIGN_SOURCE_PACKAGE_NOT_READY with one available desktop source_screenshot record and one available mobile source_screenshot record, unless an accepted screenshot-absence Source Gap or an approved waiver recorded in the package covers it. The runtime manifest validator does not read this key; the producer normalizes it and is more tolerant than this declaration (it lowercases viewport and drops or nulls malformed values rather than failing). See docs/design-source-package.md, section 'Clearing DESIGN_SOURCE_PACKAGE_NOT_READY'.

screenshot_refs.description: Alias for screenshots; read by the same producer channel.

source_screenshot_refs.description: Alias for screenshots; read by the same producer channel.

anyOf.description: Id of a visual record already registered for this package. An unresolved id contributes no proof.

sourceScreenshot.description: One source screenshot record. Only an available source_screenshot record with a recognized viewport counts toward readiness. A record without a recognized viewport, or with a kind outside the enum, is dropped by the producer and counts as nothing; an unavailable record is retained as evidence of an absence and satisfies no viewport. Field aliases the producer also accepts: viewport_key for viewport; artifact_path or file_path for path; canonical_url for url; artifact_hash or hash for sha256; a nested dimensions object for width/height; capture_timestamp for captured_at; reason for unavailable_reason.

id.description: Optional stable record id. When omitted the producer derives one from the page surface, viewport, and a content digest.

kind.description: Defaults to source_screenshot, the only kind that counts as proof. unavailable_render is accepted and retained but never satisfies a viewport. Any other kind is dropped for this channel rather than promoted to source proof.

viewport.description: Required for the record to count as proof; desktop and mobile are the readiness-required viewports and tablet is optional in v0.

availability.description: Defaults to available when path or url is present. An unavailable record requires unavailable_reason.

path.description: Screenshot file path relative to the source HTML root, not to the .campaigns-os directory. The producer records this path; it does not open the file.

url.description: Screenshot URL, when the capture is hosted rather than local.

sha256.description: Optional sha256 of the screenshot bytes, bare or sha256:-prefixed. The producer records it; it does not recompute or verify it.

unavailable_reason.description: Why no capture exists. Required when availability is unavailable.
